items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Reviewer instruction, pin test, matrix row, docs section with validating examples, pilot P1 link; two ACs under FR-01.01, no new FR.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: The reviewer instruction covers no block, unreadable file, duplicated or unpaired markers; the reviewer cannot run the render check and judges only what it can see.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Rule entries are criteria only and never waive another review axis; no commands or secrets added.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests pin the instruction words, the renderer's marker constants, the Read tool, the real loader on the docs examples, and the pilot link.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra file read per review; the agent file stays at 331 lines, under the cap.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: One small test file, one new docs section, one matrix row, no new scripts.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: render tool writes the marked block; consumer: reviewer prompt names the same markers (pinned against the renderer constants); docs examples go through the real loader.
